subject: Social Science
claimBoundary: This artifact reconciles Chapter 2 source identity and independently authorable concept boundaries only. It does not reproduce textbook prose, exercise questions, illustrations or page layouts; it does not implement lessons or assessments; and it does not make live-school, efficacy, attainment, accessibility-certification or school-specific pacing claims.

currentStructureCorroboration.use: Corroboration only. NCERT remains the canonical publisher/source authority.

learningOutcomeAlignment.source: NCERT Class VI Social Sciences learning outcomes
learningOutcomeAlignment.relevantOutcome: Explore maps for locating continents, oceans and seas.
learningOutcomeAlignment.use: Broad pedagogical alignment only; it does not replace chapter-specific source reconciliation.

reconciledTopicBoundary.title: Land and Water Distribution
reconciledTopicBoundary.scope: Earth's surface has much more water than land; compare broad Northern- and Southern-Hemisphere land/water distribution without requiring memorisation beyond the chapter-level conceptual relationship.

reconciledTopicBoundary.title: Five Oceans and Their Interconnection
reconciledTopicBoundary.scope: Identify the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic oceans; understand that named ocean boundaries are conventions within one interconnected global ocean system; distinguish oceans from smaller water-body terms at an age-appropriate level.

reconciledTopicBoundary.title: Continents, Islands and Counting Conventions
reconciledTopicBoundary.scope: Identify major continents, distinguish a continent from an island, compare relative continental size qualitatively, and recognise that continent counts can vary by convention while seven is the widely used school convention.

reconciledTopicBoundary.title: Why Oceans Matter and Why They Need Protection
reconciledTopicBoundary.scope: Explain oceans as habitats that support marine life and as major influences on climate, then connect human activity, pollution and collective protection without introducing unsupported advanced oceanography.

excludedOrDeferredBoundary: Do not copy NCERT exercise wording, crossword clues, maps, diagrams, figures or page layouts.
Do not treat ocean currents as a required Chapter 2 implementation topic unless direct canonical-source evidence is separately reconciled.
Do not introduce plate tectonics, detailed bathymetry, advanced climatology or marine chemistry into this Class 6 slice.
Do not require a learner's real location, home address, live GPS or precise coordinates.
Do not claim SAN Academy-specific chapter order, pacing, textbook edition or assessed attainment without direct evidence.
